name: Nihongo Master v1.1.8 - Road Seam Polish & Katakana Secret Stage Unlock
changelog: v1.1.8: Fixed the broken/sheared road line and lane divider seams at 2400m on Stage 10 Fuji Speedway for seamless road continuity, removed the diagonal black groove stripe across the asphalt, and enabled the Secret Stage (Stage 11: Rainbow Skyway) unlock for Katakana Arcade with unified save support and Stage 10 campaign clear progression.
